proposed_edit.new_declaration:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim)]
theorem induction_on' {motive : M ∗ N → Prop} (m : M ∗ N)
    (one : motive 1)
    (inl_mul : ∀ m x, motive x → motive (inl m * x))
    (inr_mul : ∀ n x, motive x → motive (inr n * x)) : motive m := by
  rcases mk_surjective m with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  induction x using FreeMonoid.inductionOn' with
  | one => exact one
  | mul_of x xs ih =>
    cases x <;> simpa using (by
      first | exact inl_mul _ _ ih | exact inr_mul _ _ ih)

requested_change: Rewrite `Monoid.Coprod.induction_on'` to combine the two `cases x` branches using `cases x <;> simpa using ...`, reducing duplication while keeping the same structure.

theorem tprod_nonneg [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
    [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] [L.NeBot] {f : ι → α} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    0 ≤ ∏'[L] x, f x := by
  by_cases h : Multipliable f L
  · -- `le_hasProd_of_le_prod` is the standard wrapper around `ge_of_tendsto'`
    exact le_hasProd_of_le_prod (L := L) h.hasProd (fun s ↦ s.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i)
  · simp [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable h]

@[to_additive /-- Commutativity of addition passes to smaller subobjects. -/ ]
lemma isMulCommutative_mono {S M : Type*} [SetLike S M] [Mul M] [MulMemClass S M]
    [Preorder S] [IsConcreteLE S M] {s t : S} (h : s ≤ t) [IsMulCommutative t] :
    IsMulCommutative s :=
  .of_setLike_mul_comm fun _ ha _ hb ↦
    setLike_mul_comm (mem_of_le_of_mem h ha) (mem_of_le_of_mem h hb)

private theorem commutator_sup_left' (H K N : Subgroup G) [(⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆).Normal] :
    ⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · -- map to the quotient where both commutators vanish
    have hH : ⁅H, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_left
    have hK : ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_right
    -- `simp` handles the kernel / map_eq_bot bookkeeping
    rw [← QuotientGroup.ker_mk' (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆), ← Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff,
      map_commutator, Subgroup.commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer] at hH hK ⊢
    simpa [map_sup] using sup_le hH hK
  · exact sup_le (commutator_mono_left le_sup_left) (commutator_mono_left le_sup_right)

requested_change: Replace the `rw [map_sup]; exact ...` tail with `simpa [map_sup] using ...` (keeping the same earlier `rw ... at ... ⊢`).
